title: The Sense Paradigm for World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models predict the future in an embedding space rather than in pixels. An encoder trained only to predict collapses and maps every observation to the same point, so existing models add a mechanism against collapse, such as a target network, a variance penalty or a distribution penalty. These mechanisms keep the embedding from collapsing, but they leave its distances without meaning, and the model cannot tell a reversible transition from an irreversible one. We propose Sense, a single cross-entropy loss over the directed distance $d(x\to y)=\sum_i \mathrm{ReLU}(y_i-x_i)$ that replaces these mechanisms. The loss avoids collapse on its own, and since the encoder no longer needs the predictor, the predictor is fitted afterwards to fixed embeddings by plain regression. translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型在嵌入空间而非像素空间中预测未来。仅以预测为目标训练的编码器会发生坍缩，将所有观测映射到同一点，因此现有模型需要加入抗坍缩机制，例如目标网络、方差惩罚或分布惩罚。这些机制虽然能防止嵌入坍缩，但会使嵌入中的距离失去意义，导致模型无法区分可逆转移与不可逆转移。我们提出Sense，一种基于有向距离 $d(x\to y)=\sum_i \mathrm{ReLU}(y_i-x_i)$ 的单一交叉熵损失，用以替代这些机制。该损失本身即可避免坍缩，并且由于编码器不再依赖预测器，预测器可以在固定的嵌入上通过简单的回归进行事后拟合。在四个像素环境中，Sense学习到的回报距离检测不可逆转移的AUC介于0.95和1.00之间，而LeWorldModel则停留在（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: Sense范式用单一的基于有向距离的交叉熵损失替代传统抗坍缩机制，在自身避免嵌入坍缩的同时保留距离的语义意义，使世界模型能够有效检测不可逆转移。
en_tdlr: The Sense paradigm replaces traditional anti-collapse mechanisms with a single cross-entropy loss over directed distance, inherently avoiding embedding collapse while preserving meaningful distance semantics, enabling world models to detect irreversible transitions.
